subject: English
question_text: Write a dialogue between Eva and Jaba about afforestation
stimulus: and how to preserve ecological balance.' 10 Subject Code : down trees. Trees absorb significant amount of carbon dioxide from the air and deliver oxygen instead which in turns, helps us survive. Although we can't control the cosmological movement of the earth or the change in the environment, we can control the greenhouse effect by reducing the emission of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
guide_solution: Dialogue writing A dialogue about food adulteration : Myself : Have you seen the raid on food production houses? Akshara : Yes, the mobile court is doing the right task to stop food adulteration. Myself : The adulteration of food is increasing beyond any limit. Food sellers are using toxic chemicals to preserve food. Akshara : Yes, these toxic chemicals are used for industrial purposes. These can cause kidney damage, heart failure and various other diseases.
